goal: Audit ALFRED Chicago Fed NFCI/ANFCI actual historical publication vintages and availability before joining to BTCI. This is a source access/PIT pilot, not a trained indicator.
earliestEligiblePublication: 2011-05-25 ALFRED; Chicago Fed first index around April 2011. Series data earlier than first publication must never be used as if known.
vintageAccess: Try official FRED/ALFRED API only if FRED_API_KEY secret already installed. For each series/asOf request realtime_start=asOf and realtime_end=asOf, observation_start=2010-01-01, observation_end=asOf, file_type=json, limit<=10000. Do not log API key or URLs carrying secrets. Require returned realtime attributes equal requested vintage and each observation date <= asOf.
noKey: If no FRED_API_KEY present, inspect public ALFRED form/release date calendar, archive source HTML and calendar raw plus SHA in R2, mark VINTAGE_DATA_ACCESS_NOT_AUTHORIZED; no current revised NFCI values substituted or early warning scores inferred.
releaseCalendarValidation: At least 700 distinct ALFRED release dates between May2011 and Oct2026, all ISO dates; this calendar by itself does not prove NFCI observation was revised in each release and index may have shifted day due holidays.
publicationGuard: For later BTC Sunday join use ONLY latest observation in vintage already published by the Sunday (Wednesday/Thursday timing). Sampling source at pre-specified asOf date may be a next-day corrected value; vintage timestamp alone does not certify intraday clock.
report: Source status, release date coverage, detected form parameters, vintage sample source SHA and asOf records if accessible, all in versioned R2 readback manifest.
limitations: Do not treat public revised NFCI history as past publication values
FRED API key is not requested from user unless necessary and only via secure secret, not chat text.
